families.name: Non-rewriting Temporal Truth

origins.evidence: FR2 effective time vs observed_at; append-only regime revisions; no future leakage.
Authority changes are prospective; earlier valid admissions/evidence remain immutable history.
Generation/watchdog currentness supersedes stale admission-fence interpretation without pretending the old fence never existed.
Registry/Attempt history and late evidence correct current resolution without erasing earlier uncertainty.
Event journal/revisions preserve semantic history while current checkpoint is a projection.

families.sharedInvariant: Later current knowledge/state may supersede a present projection without rewriting what was historically admitted, observed or true-at-the-time. Currentness and history are separate queries.
families.transportBoundary: Does not imply one universal temporal schema. Effective time, knowledge time, authority epoch, generation and task revision remain owner-native.

families.name: UNKNOWN Is a First-Class Action State

origins.evidence: Lost/orphaned/commitState unknown prevent speculative redispatch.
FR2 transition windows and FR3 carrier evidence return UNKNOWN rather than fabricated exact identity/quality.
Evidence actionability/claim support can remain unresolved; empty observation is not global absence.
Currentness/evidence and authority experiments preserve unresolved states.
Challenge/unresolved discriminator and correct abstention are review states.

families.sharedInvariant: Missing, stale, conflicting or insufficient evidence must not be collapsed into false, absent, failed or safe-to-retry when those states imply different next actions.
families.transportBoundary: Shared semantic inequality only; each owner defines its own unknown causes and recovery action.

families.name: Projection Is Not Authority

origins.evidence: Core A6: Context is selected view of separately owned state.
Current relation is disposable projection; temporal identity evidence remains canonical.
ActionableEvidenceFor is decision-scoped projection over evidence/claims, not a new evidence owner.
C1 Boundary can be inherited from owner/Task/Run contract rather than copied into packet authority.
Project quick index derives from canonical project array and does not become second directory authority.

families.sharedInvariant: A selected/current/derived view may be useful without becoming the source of truth or gaining mutation/semantic authority over what it projects.
families.transportBoundary: Does not require identical projection data structures or a central view service.

families.name: Identity Is Bound to Relevant Invariants, Not Labels or Bytes

origins.evidence: PAL F19 old Run survives Harness implementation change when lineage/commitment/authority/evidence invariants remain.
FR2 ticker is label not identity; identity events can change reference semantics without changing economic object.
Network capability identity binds path/generation/current evidence, not friendly node/profile name.
Authority digest/producer/key/version identity survives rotation and binds historical verification.
clientRequestId/Operation identity binds enforceable request facts; replay must not reinterpret current world.

families.sharedInvariant: Continuity depends on preserving the invariants that give an object/commitment meaning; byte equality, ticker/name equality, or implementation revision alone is neither necessary nor sufficient.
families.transportBoundary: No universal identity tuple follows; each owner must name its non-bypassable invariants.

families.name: Evidence Availability Is Not Knowledge/Promotion Authority

origins.evidence: R8 separates Evidence existence, actionability, claim support and Knowledge.
Promotion Gate requires support maturity + falsifier/boundary + implementation-independent representation; recurrence/control value alone insufficient.
Reusable procedural knowledge topology and Run authority remain separate; new installed cognition does not silently enter old Run.
World Model Loop promotes only after cross-project evidence; local observations stay owner facts.

families.sharedInvariant: Evidence can exist, recur, or be retrievable without earning stable Knowledge, Core doctrine, or future decision authority. Promotion is a separate evidence decision.
families.transportBoundary: Does not define one universal Knowledge object or promotion daemon.

families.name: Capability, Authority, Commitment and Consequence Are Distinct

origins.evidence: Effect kernel: Proposal != commitment; execution result != external effect receipt != semantic completion.
Semantic MCP narrows exact network authority and prohibited effects despite generic root execution capability.
Carrier/admission/capital authority and external effect/reconciliation remain distinct.
Frozen grant/authority digest, admission and evidence are separate.
Joint capability and decision authority are not equivalent.

families.sharedInvariant: Being able to perform an operation does not grant authority; admitting/committing it does not prove the external consequence occurred; process completion does not prove domain completion.
families.transportBoundary: No single permission/effect object should own all stages; ownership remains domain-specific.

families.name: Contraction and Deletion Are Epistemic Operators

origins.evidence: TM0 RT8 and Existence Gauntlet; deletion tests required before shared-layer promotion.
GC1/GC2/GC6 remove zero-consumer or duplicate semantics while preserving product/recovery equivalence.
AE1/C1 deletion falsifiers and evidence-first contraction remove standing batteries/services.
13 closed PAL apparatus elements removed after evidence became durable.
Spacing-only candidate discarded after real render failure rather than accumulated as compatibility.

families.sharedInvariant: Removing, narrowing or localizing a structure is an experiment: survival reveals a smaller invariant; breakage reveals what the layer actually owned. Historical evidence need not imply active executability.
families.transportBoundary: Deletion is not a universal default for participant-owned data, legal records, unique evidence or irreversible external state.

families.name: Reversibility Expands Search, but Recovery Does Not Erase Consequence

origins.evidence: Disposable Workspaces, exact replay, UNKNOWN and effect reconciliation.
Core A8/A11 and TM0 RT5.
Self-owned bounded labs allow aggressive falsification while third-party consequence remains excluded.
Error/recovery work values bounded failure and recovery, not first-try correctness.
Editable source + reproducible render + approved Output separates reversible iteration from publication.

families.sharedInvariant: Cheap reversible interior experimentation expands the practical hypothesis frontier; irreversible/shared effects require narrower commitment/reconciliation, and recovery cannot pretend an outside consequence did not happen.
families.transportBoundary: Simulation/reversibility cannot substitute for real social/economic/adversarial consequence evidence.

families.name: Consumer Pressure Determines Layer Admission

origins.evidence: Two ordinary consumer failures stopped at L2 expression; no deeper rewrite.
Directory problem solved by local canonical-data projection after spacing-only failure; no Core aesthetic law.
First ordinary production succeeded with a production-local omission fix; architecture stayed unchanged.
A13 and provider/consumer-first research method encode burden before abstraction.

families.sharedInvariant: A lower/shared layer should change only after a reproduced consumer failure proves higher owner-local treatment insufficient; stop descent at the first truthful successful treatment.
families.transportBoundary: Some failures may legitimately begin in a lower layer; the rule is causal localization, not mandatory sequential edits.

families.name: Current Use, Option Value and Capability Value Are Distinct

origins.evidence: PAL P2 scoped egress later gained Finance/Workstation use; F11 rejected generic option-aware retention.
Resource -> actionable option/capability/effect conversion and demand-scoped ecology.
Future Control Value distinguishes knowledge worth internalizing from merely retrievable durable facts.
Installed/provisional equipment worlds are not mature creative capability until real work consumes them.

families.sharedInvariant: Zero current consumption does not imply zero future option value; possible future value also does not justify retaining everything. Value depends on reacquisition/carrying cost, future workloads, authority and conversion into capability/effect.
families.transportBoundary: No universal option-value scalar or retain/delete rule is supported.

families.name: Stop When Further Evidence Cannot Change the Current Decision

origins.evidence: Task search model completion conditions and R5/R6 evidence-first contraction.
TM0 RT10/RT12 and Harness P4 observation-efficiency pressure.
GVA/alpha research funnels allow zero survivors/zero effects; negative/no-attempt outcomes close branches.
GX1 stops saturated live-model repetitions/timeouts when evidence is already discriminative.

families.sharedInvariant: Research completion is not plan completion or mutation count; lawful abstention/stopping is progress when available next observations have poor decision-changing information value relative to cost.
families.transportBoundary: No global observation threshold; new capability/cheap evidence may reopen the frontier.

families.name: Shared Semantics Do Not Imply Shared Mechanism

origins.evidence: A13, World Model Loop and TM0 RT7 explicitly require materially different recurrence + deletion test.
R7/R8 prefer owner-native claims/projections over universal ecology/evidence managers.
GVA rejects universal OpportunityKernel; FR2 persists owner-specific immutable datasets rather than generic graph engine.
CA-LIC laws inform engineering but do not earn license/revocation/DRM service.
Multi-credential provider machinery remains local until second real consumer reproduces responsibility.

families.sharedInvariant: The same semantic distinction recurring across owners is evidence for a shared claim only after recurrence; it does not by itself justify a central implementation, schema or service.
families.transportBoundary: A central mechanism is still justified when a truly unowned non-bypassable responsibility recurs and deletion breaks multiple workloads.

warning: Cross-owner convergence families are explanatory hypotheses/constraints, not owner-local causal histories or current owner truth. This control intentionally tests the cost of using them as the only default theory surface.
